title: The Real Effects of Supply Chain Transparency Regulation – Evidence from Section 1502 of the Dodd-Frank Act
sources_checked: Paper sample record output/samples/records/jar-e00ce9bb6ed8.json: conflict_by_cell is a 2010–2019 African cell-year sample; model_results output/models/records/jar-e00ce9bb6ed8.json maps the focal Table 5 column (1) fit to page 21. These records were used for sample and table mapping.

The assigned Stata working copies under work/ were checked at the fit, table, and time-filter lines cited in each row; the accepted construction code in the assigned generation_002 package was read at the source/merge/filter/export lines listed in work/source_coverage.json.

Read-only time-column coverage checks of the 12 assigned Conflict Minerals SAS inputs and six accepted Stata handoffs are summarized, with SHA-256 checksums and column type/format, in work/source_coverage.json. The accepted package ACLED year field ends in 2019; the annual and monthly scaffolds end in 2019; mineral_prices ends in 2019; handoffs cover cell-years through 2019 and Eastern DRC months through 2019-12.

The assigned smelters.dta handoff was inspected metadata-only and by year/outcome completeness; level fits cover 2014–2018 and change fits 2015–2018. The accepted SAS builder requires smelter_level_data.sas7bdat, which is absent from the assigned package.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog (SAS PROC CONTENTS inventory dated 2026-09-28; SHA-256 recorded in work/source_coverage.json): exact member-name check across 958 DATA members found none of the accepted Conflict Minerals source members or SMELTER_LEVEL_DATA. This catalog check does not establish absence in every local path; no recursive storage scan or new source acquisition was performed.
changes: No scientific launch, code adaptation, or data construction was performed because no current-vintage source route supporting the requested extension was verified. Original cutoffs, sample screens, and estimators remain unmodified.
limitations: Conflict scopes requiring extension beyond 2019 are blocked at preflight: the assigned accepted-vintage ACLED input has years 2007–2019, the year and year_yyyymm scaffolds end in 2019, and the checked current local SAS catalog lacks the exact accepted source members. No current-vintage inputs for 2020–2024 or verified compatible builder refresh were available in the checked sources. Existing handoffs are historical evidence only.

The pre-2015 placebo fits in Table IA-8, Table IA-5, and Table IA-7 retain the accepted year < 2015 restriction. Their model-specific usable end is 2014; the requested five-year endpoint does not add observations under the original design.

The smelter source route remains blocked because the exact hand-collected smelter_level_data input and a current disclosure/conformance crosswalk were not verified; the assigned Stata handoff ends in 2018.

All five inherited predecessor gaps remain in force and are carried into the final prior_gaps field: Eastern DRC xtpsse, Full Sample xtpsse, seven FECT branches, and the two unresolved additional-analysis caller mappings. No estimator substitution or input inference was made.

The prior accepted Table IA-9 comparison recorded four printed column-5 discrepancies versus the same-package author reference (CMD_Rule coefficient -0.075 vs 0.137; standard error 0.064 vs 0.027; CMD_G coefficient -0.000 vs 0.001; standard error 0.001 vs 0.000). The cause was unassessed in the predecessor and remains unresolved because no extension fit was launched.

prior_gaps.description: The original Table IA-14 line 172 calls unavailable xtpsse. This is the final source estimator; no later command consumes its estimate or stored results. No installation or estimator substitution is made. The source model is explicitly declared as a gap.

The original Table 5 Poisson line 40 calls unavailable xtpsse. The downstream esttab at line 42 is retained because it exports the already-stored spatial-HAC fit; its output is named Table_5_spatial_only.csv to disclose the omitted Poisson panel. The next Table IA-6 section clears stored estimates at line 46 before fitting its own models. No xtpsse result is invented or replaced.

Seven unavailable fect branches and only their directly following graph exports are omitted: original lines 28-29 (IA-15), 37-38 (IA-16), 47-48 (IA-19 democracy sample), 65-66 (IA-19 non-democracy sample), 95-96 (Figure 2), 123-124 (IA-18 democracy sample), and 140-141 (IA-18 non-democracy sample). Each fect call has no downstream estimator/result-state consumer; the associated graph export is its direct output. Explicit filters, reloads, native didregress figures, spatial-HAC models, coefficient plot, full samples, seeds in any retained programs, and all specified years/horizons/cutoffs remain unchanged. No estimator substitute is used.
